title: Large Pre-trained EEG Model for Electrical Status Epilepticus during Sleep Detection

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Large Pre-trained EEG Model for Electrical Status Epilepticus during Sleep Detection》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Electrical status epilepticus during sleep (ESES) is a severe but often underdiagnosed epileptic encephalopathy that can significantly impair cognitive development in children.

evidence.text: Electrical status epilepticus during sleep (ESES) is a severe but often underdiagnosed epileptic encephalopathy that can significantly impair cognitive development in children.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Large Pre-trained EEG Model for Electrical Status Epilepticus during Sleep Detection》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】To address these limitations, this paper introduces a novel ESES automatic detection framework based on a large pre-trained EEG model.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The framework employs a pre-trained NeuroEncoder to extract temporal and frequency features from spike-and-slow-wave complexes, and uniquely incorporates a temporal and spatial embedding module to enhance the model's ability to recognize spatiotemporal patterns.

evidence.text: To address these limitations, this paper introduces a novel ESES automatic detection framework based on a large pre-trained EEG model.

The framework employs a pre-trained NeuroEncoder to extract temporal and frequency features from spike-and-slow-wave complexes, and uniquely incorporates a temporal and spatial embedding module to enhance the model's ability to recognize spatiotemporal patterns.
